{{Top|leg}}
The '''Rodmark Weapons Plant''' was a weapons factory in the industrial zone of [[Iskaayuma/Legends|Iskaayuma]], on [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]]. It was a stronghold of the [[Roolek clan]], most of whom had fled Rodia after [[Navik/Legends|Navik the Red]] ordered his [[Chattza clan/Legends|Chattza]] [[Protector (Rin'na)|Protectors]] to hunt them down.

Ten Rooleks attended a show of the [[Rodian Galactic Drama Troupe]] in the city, after which they took their [[speeder/Legends|speeders]] back to the factory, where around 100 Rodians were working. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Inntak]] knew about their presence there and hired a group of beings to hunt down any Rooleks. The group of [[mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] followed the Rooleks to the factory. 

This led to the discovery of the factory's role as a stronghold, for which Inntak was willing to pay an additional large reward.
